purpose: hand-off from deploy-runner to eval-closer for independent evaluation of the deployed checkpoint
provisional_reason: deployment candidate is the seed42 SFT adapter merged provisionally; T12/KD was not run and the Lead has not frozen a final adapter

modality_files.processor_config.json: copied verbatim from base model: image_seq_len=64
modality_files.preprocessor_config.json: copied verbatim from base model: size/max_image_size 2048, do_image_splitting=true

deployment_artifact.packaging_note: runtime overrides (image_size=384, do_image_splitting=false, image_seq_len=36) are applied by inference code per call; the on-disk defaults stay at the shipped values

equivalence.contract: base+adapter and merged checkpoint must produce byte-identical output_text for the same image/question

official_evaluation_commands: python -m src.eval.run_zeroshot --run-id <RUN_ID> --dataset synthetic --split eval --data data/synthetic_eval.jsonl --output results/zeroshot_<RUN_ID>.json --details-output results/eval_<RUN_ID>_details.jsonl --expected-n 1000 --model-path adapters/merged/sft_v1_merged --image-size 384 --max-new-tokens 64 --batch-size 1 --seed 42 --device cpu

python -m src.eval.run_zeroshot --run-id <RUN_ID> --dataset refcoco --split val --data data/refcoco_val.jsonl --output results/zeroshot_<RUN_ID>.json --details-output results/eval_<RUN_ID>_details.jsonl --expected-n 1000 --model-path adapters/merged/sft_v1_merged --image-size 384 --max-new-tokens 64 --batch-size 1 --seed 42 --device cpu
official_evaluation_note: the frozen evaluator loads any full checkpoint through --model-path, so the merged deployment candidate is scored without touching evaluator code. CPU throughput: ~1.55 s/image at 2 threads on the 50-image benchmark, so one 1000-image set is ~26 min on an unloaded CPU (slower while T7 training shares CPU). GPU must not be used for this while T7 holds it.

gpu_bf16.reason: GPU leased to T7 training; Lead instructed CPU-only T14/T15
gpu_bf16.diagnostic_reference_only: existing SFT evaluation details recorded ~1.33 s/image elapsed_seconds_diagnostic (not a warmed 50-image benchmark; must not be copied into Table 3 as measured)

latency_evidence.comparability: fp32 and int8 used the same 50 selected ids (digest recorded) and warmup=5

onnx_int8.claim: not_run; optimum-onnx requires transformers<4.58 while the project is frozen at 5.19.0

torch_int8_dynamic.claim: not a deployment candidate; quality collapse

table_implications.table1_plus_quantized_row: not_run (no viable quantized artifact); must not be filled with int8 dynamic numbers

table3_deployment.cpu_int8_latency: measured but negative accuracy; keep as a negative result, not a deployment claim

demo_evidence.browser_confirmation: pending Lead human confirmation; agent evidence is HTTP+API round-trip only
